member.summary: Renumbers the hierarchy of document block elements for a specific page, updating their hierarchy levels and ensuring consistency across parent and child elements.
member.remarks: This method processes the provided ordered elements to assign a hierarchical numbering scheme based on the page number and the position of each element. It updates the hierarchy levels for parent elements and recursively renumbers child elements to maintain a consistent hierarchy. The method ensures that all updates are persisted and handles any errors that occur during the process.
member.param: A list of all document block elements, including both ordered and unordered elements.
A list of document block elements ordered by their intended hierarchy for the specified page.
The page number to which the elements belong. Used as the base for hierarchy numbering.
The format string for numbering the page, such as "00#" or "000#".
member.returns: A containing a boolean value indicating whether the renumbering operation was successful. If the operation fails, the result will contain error details.
